$comment: Anti-patterns dari The Mom Test (mapping §4). Berlaku sebagai guardrail bagi user DAN self-check reasoning engine.

anti_patterns.name: Fishing for Compliments
anti_patterns.symptom: Pertanyaan mencari restu: 'Menurut Anda ide ini bagus?' / 'Anda suka tidak?'

anti_patterns.name: Pathos Problem (Ego Exposure)
anti_patterns.symptom: Membuka ego: 'Tolong jujur, saya kuat kok' — orang tetap menarik pukulannya; data menjadi fluff pelindung perasaan

anti_patterns.name: Pitch Mode
anti_patterns.symptom: 'No, you don't understand yet…' / 'Yeah, but this can also…' — enthusiastic monologue; customer stops talking about their problem

anti_patterns.name: Premature Zoom
anti_patterns.symptom: Zoom into specific problem details before confirming the user cares — producing data that looks like validation but is a false positive

anti_patterns.name: Too Formal
anti_patterns.symptom: 'Terima kasih sudah mau diwawancara…' / skala 1-5 — meeting formal memicu jawaban interview, bukan kebenaran

anti_patterns.name: Learning Bottleneck
anti_patterns.symptom: Satu orang pegang semua percakapan customer: 'Anda urus produk, saya urus customer' — de-facto dictator + sinyal hilang
